title: Combating Online Phishing and Spoofing Scams
what_it_is: Combating Online Phishing and Spoofing Scams

sections.label: OCBC scams not cyber attack
sections.summary: Desmond Tan will speak on enforcement and public education, and the OCBC scams were not caused by a cyber attack or cybersecurity weaknesses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Minister of State Desmond Tan will speak later about enforcement as well as the continuing, crucial efforts in public education.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: But, first, let me assure Members that the OCBC scams were not the result of a cyber attack or weaknesses in cybersecurity.

sections.label: OCBC scam was deception
sections.summary: The OCBC scam was not a cyber attack or cybersecurity breach but a classic case of deception, executed with speed and repeated at scale.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: The OCBC scam was, therefore, not a result of a cyber attack or a breach of cybersecurity, which, typically, involves hacking or breaking into a system to steal information or assets.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Instead, it was a classic case of deception, executed with speed and repeated at scale.

sections.label: Scam websites blocked 2020 2021
sections.summary: About 500 suspected scam websites were blocked in 2020, and 12,000 such websites were blocked by 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: In 2020, we blocked about 500 suspected scam websites.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: By 2021, the net had been cast much more widely and 12,000 such websites were blocked.

sections.label: OCBC scam websites blocked
sections.summary: In the OCBC case, more than 350 scam websites have been blocked.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: In the OCBC case, more than 350 scam websites have been blocked.

sections.label: Telcos block overseas calls
sections.summary: Every month, the telcos block around 15 million, or one in seven, of all incoming overseas calls to Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Every month, the telcos block around 15 million, or one in seven of all incoming overseas calls to Singapore.

sections.label: Plus prefix and scam call blocking
sections.summary: Since April 2020, telcos added the "+" prefix for incoming overseas calls and plan analytics to block up to 55 million suspected scam calls monthly.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Since April 2020, telcos have also added the “+” prefix for all incoming overseas calls, to help alert their customers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Our telcos plan to incorporate additional analytics to block more of these suspected scam calls.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: We estimate that up to 55 million calls will be blocked each month.

sections.label: Alphanumeric ID registration requirements
sections.summary: MAS requires major retail banks to register alphanumeric IDs, Government agencies will do likewise, and IMDA will require SMS providers and telcos to check senders against the registry.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: MAS has decided that all major retail banks must sign up to register the alphanumeric IDs they use to communicate with their customers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: The Government has also committed that all its agencies will do likewise.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: In addition, IMDA will require SMS service providers and telcos to check SMS senders against the registry.

sections.label: Unregistered alphanumeric ID SMS
sections.summary: Businesses not registering alphanumeric IDs will have SMS messages show only their telephone number, and IMDA will study whether to mandate registration.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Businesses that choose not to register alphanumeric IDs will have their SMS messages appear only with their telephone number.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Given the implications, IMDA will study this matter carefully before deciding whether or not to mandate the registration of all alphanumeric IDs.

sections.label: Banks discontinue SMS alphanumeric IDs
sections.summary: MAS has ensured that banks discontinue their use of alphanumeric IDs in SMS communications with customers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: MAS has ensured that banks discontinue their use in SMS communications with customers.

sections.label: Scams did not hack IT
sections.summary: In the series of scams, the criminals did not hack into the bank's IT system to steal money.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: In the series of scams, the criminals did not hack into the bank's IT system to steal money.

sections.label: Enhanced telco network safeguards
sections.summary: Telcos will be required to put in place enhanced safeguards in networks, including blocking scam calls, SMSes and websites.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: As part of our efforts to continuously strengthen our defences, we will require telcos to put in place enhanced safeguards in our networks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: This includes blocking scam calls, SMSes and websites.

sections.label: Digital for Life scam education
sections.summary: IMDA launched the Digital for Life Movement, with Lions Befrienders, SG Digital Office and the Media Literacy Council providing scam education and resources.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: As part of these efforts, IMDA launched the Digital for Life (DfL) Movement to galvanise the people, private and public sectors to provide Singaporeans with skills, tools and habits to navigate the digital domain safely and confidently.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: For example, the Lions Befrienders led a project, "Say No to Scams", where staff and volunteers teach seniors about staying safe from online scams and harms.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: This included measures, such as changing settings and installing apps, to increase security on smartphones.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: They are also working on a scam simulation app to help seniors identify scams.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: For example, the curriculum for seniors offered by the SG Digital Office has been updated to provide cybersecurity tips on topics, such as Digital Government services, e-payments and digital transactions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: The Media Literacy Council (MLC) has also produced tip sheets on e-commerce scams, online impersonation scams and loan scams.

sections.label: Ecosystem changes cost convenience
sections.summary: Making these changes across the ecosystem may result in additional cost and some loss of convenience.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Across the ecosystem, making these changes may result in additional cost and some loss of convenience.
